description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Lex Model Building Service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API calls to create, delete, retrieve, and manage Lex models, intent versions, slot types, and associated resources.

classes.name: LexModelBuildingServiceClient
classes.description: The client class used to interact with the Amazon Lex Model Building Service, extending the generic AwsClient and providing specific method annotations for Lex operations.

methods.name: createBotVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing bot.

methods.name: createBotVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new version of a bot.
